B[0,j] and B[1,j] stay resident at spad rows 0-31 per output column block j, while each A[i,k] tile streams through rows 32-47: since A[i,0] is dead after the overwrite-mode slice-0 compute, A[i,1] is mvin'd into the same rows 32-47 and accumulated (out_addr bit30=1) onto the same accumulator rows 0-15, then mvout with bit31/bit29 set. This keeps live scratchpad usage at 48 rows exactly, satisfying the capacity constraint. Each compute uses accumulated=false with bd=4294967295 and each follows a preload staging a real B address; accumulate and mvout only touch accumulators initialized by the preceding overwrite compute. 51 commands total: 4 config, 10 mvin, 12 preload, 12 compute, 6 mvout, 1 fence; every mvin tile is 256 int8 bytes, so total DMA input is 2560 bytes, the minimum possible for this workload."}
